about: Player ids that moved in NBA Savant (1.0 of this file, Nov 26 2026): each old id (a Basketball-Reference "br:" id) and the NBA id that now holds the same player. remap_moved_ids.py applies it to the archive (savant-data.json: rows, comps and the top-level moved_ids the page, the site's API and the connector read to redirect an old id), the All-Savant slots and the page's awards; build_historical.py and gen_historical_comps.py apply it on a rebuild. 1.1 (same day): the 58 players before 1996-97 that no name matched, matched instead by season, team and minutes as GM Savant 1.0.2 does (Mark Jones, br:jonesma02, stays: NBA.com has no career totals for its only Mark Jones of the time). Add a line whenever a player's id changes; never remove one. old_slugs: the player-page addresses (/player/<slug>) the split careers had that no longer exist, each with the page of the whole career; vercel.json redirects them. names: a display name to use on every one of a player's rows where NBA.com's is abbreviated.
